name: RustDesk-AIO
description:
Self-host your own RustDesk Server, it is free and open source. This container includes both the RustDesk Server and the RustDesk Relay in one and starts it.

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@xiaoditx

ports.name: TCP Port - RustDesk Server/Relay
ports.description:
Necessary default ports for the server:
TCP: 21115, 21116, 21118
UDP: 21116
Necessary default ports for the relay:
TCP: 21117, 21119

variables.name: Enable RustDesk Server
variables.description:
The server needs by default the following ports to work properly:
TCP: 21115, 21116, 21118
UDP: 21116

variables.description: Enter your extra start up parameters for the server here if necessary.

variables.description:
